principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the area of different shapes and formatting the output. This creates a violation of SRP as the class has multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation and output formatting responsibilities into different classes. Create a new class called AreaFormatter that will handle output generation.

principle_violations.reason: The sum method in the AreaCalculator class must be modified to account for new shapes, violating the open/closed principle. Each time a new shape is added, the sum method would need to be altered.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a Shape interface and have Circle and Square implement this interface. Use a polymorphic approach to calculate the area within the shape classes, allowing the AreaCalculator to remain unchanged when new shapes are added.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
